56: /**
57:  * This class facilitates interaction with Coordinator/Overlord leader nodes. Instance of this class is injected
58:  * via Guice with annotations @Coordinator or @IndexingService .
59:  * Usage:
60:  * Request request = druidLeaderClient.makeRequest(HttpMethod, requestPath)
61:  * request.setXXX(..)
62:  * FullResponseHolder responseHolder = druidLeaderClient.go(request)
63:  */
64: public class DruidLeaderClient
65: {
66:   private final Logger log = new Logger(DruidLeaderClient.class);
67: 
68:   private static final int MAX_RETRIES = 5;
69: 
70:   private final HttpClient httpClient;
71:   private final DruidNodeDiscoveryProvider druidNodeDiscoveryProvider;
72:   private final NodeRole nodeRoleToWatch;
73: 
74:   private final String leaderRequestPath;

76:   private LifecycleLock lifecycleLock = new LifecycleLock();
77:   private DruidNodeDiscovery druidNodeDiscovery;
78:   private AtomicReference<String> currentKnownLeader = new AtomicReference<>();
79: 
80:   public DruidLeaderClient(
81:       HttpClient httpClient,
82:       DruidNodeDiscoveryProvider druidNodeDiscoveryProvider,
83:       NodeRole nodeRoleToWatch,
84:       String leaderRequestPath
85:   )
86:   {
87:     this.httpClient = httpClient;
88:     this.druidNodeDiscoveryProvider = druidNodeDiscoveryProvider;
89:     this.nodeRoleToWatch = nodeRoleToWatch;
90:     this.leaderRequestPath = leaderRequestPath;
91:   }
92: 
93:   @LifecycleStart
94:   public void start()
95:   {
96:     if (!lifecycleLock.canStart()) {
97:       throw new ISE("can't start.");
98:     }
99: 
100:     try {
101:       druidNodeDiscovery = druidNodeDiscoveryProvider.getForNodeRole(nodeRoleToWatch);
102:       lifecycleLock.started();
103:       log.debug("Started.");
104:     }
105:     finally {
106:       lifecycleLock.exitStart();
107:     }
108:   }
109: 
110:   @LifecycleStop
111:   public void stop()
112:   {
113:     if (!lifecycleLock.canStop()) {
114:       throw new ISE("can't stop.");
115:     }
116: 
117:     log.debug("Stopped.");
118:   }
119: 
120:   /**
121:    * Make a Request object aimed at the leader. Throws IOException if the leader cannot be located.
122:    */
123:   public Request makeRequest(HttpMethod httpMethod, String urlPath) throws IOException
124:   {
125:     Preconditions.checkState(lifecycleLock.awaitStarted(1, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS));
126:     return new Request(httpMethod, new URL(StringUtils.format("%s%s", getCurrentKnownLeader(true), urlPath)));
127:   }
128: 
129:   public StringFullResponseHolder go(Request request) throws IOException, InterruptedException
130:   {
131:     return go(request, new StringFullResponseHandler(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
132:   }
133: 
134:   /**
135:    * Executes a Request object aimed at the leader. Throws IOException if the leader cannot be located.
136:    */
137:   public <T, H extends FullResponseHolder<T>> H go(Request request, HttpResponseHandler<H, H> responseHandler)
138:       throws IOException, InterruptedException
139:   {
140:     Preconditions.checkState(lifecycleLock.awaitStarted(1, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS));
141:     for (int counter = 0; counter < MAX_RETRIES; counter++) {
142:       final H fullResponseHolder;
143:       try {
144:         try {
145:           fullResponseHolder = httpClient.go(request, responseHandler).get();
146:         }
147:         catch (ExecutionException e) {
148:           // Unwrap IOExceptions and ChannelExceptions, re-throw others
149:           Throwables.propagateIfInstanceOf(e.getCause(), IOException.class);
150:           Throwables.propagateIfInstanceOf(e.getCause(), ChannelException.class);
151:           throw new RE(e, "HTTP request to[%s] failed", request.getUrl());
152:         }
153:       }
154:       catch (IOException | ChannelException ex) {
155:         // can happen if the node is stopped.
156:         log.warn(ex, "Request[%s] failed.", request.getUrl());
157:         Iterator<DiscoveryDruidNode> nodeIterator = druidNodeDiscovery.getAllNodes().iterator();
158:         String leader = null;
159:         if (nodeIterator.hasNext()) {
160:           DiscoveryDruidNode discoveryNode = nodeIterator.next();
161:           DruidNode druidNode = discoveryNode.getDruidNode();
162:           String nodeHost = druidNode.getHost();
163:           int tlsPort = druidNode.getTlsPort();
164:           int plaintextPort = druidNode.getPlaintextPort();
165:           boolean tlsEnabled = druidNode.isEnableTlsPort();
166:           boolean plaintextEnabled = druidNode.isEnablePlaintextPort();
167:           String serviceScheme = tlsPort >= 0 ? "https" : "http";
168:           String hostAndPortToUse = null;
169:           if (tlsEnabled) {
170:             hostAndPortToUse = HostAndPort.fromParts(nodeHost, tlsPort).toString();
171:           } else if (plaintextEnabled && plaintextPort < 0) {
172:             hostAndPortToUse = HostAndPort.fromString(nodeHost).toString();
173:           } else if (plaintextEnabled) {
174:             hostAndPortToUse = HostAndPort.fromParts(nodeHost, plaintextPort).toString();
175:           }
176:           leader = StringUtils.format("%s://%s", serviceScheme, hostAndPortToUse);
177:         }
178:         currentKnownLeader.set(leader);
179:         if (leader == null) {
180:           throw new IOE("No known server");
181:         }
182:         try {
183:           URL failedUrl = request.getUrl();
184:           String query = failedUrl.getQuery();
185:           String path = failedUrl.getPath();
186:           URL retryUrl;
187:           if (query == null) {
188:             retryUrl = new URL(StringUtils.format("%s%s", leader, path));
189:           } else {
190:             retryUrl = new URL(StringUtils.format("%s%s?%s", leader, path, query));
191:           }
192:           Request retryRequest = new Request(request.getMethod(), retryUrl);
193:           for (Map.Entry<String, Collection<String>> headerEntry : request.getHeaders().asMap().entrySet()) {
194:             retryRequest.addHeaderValues(headerEntry.getKey(), headerEntry.getValue());
195:           }
196:           if (request.hasContent()) {
197:             retryRequest.setContent(request.getContent());
198:           }
199:           request = retryRequest;
200:           continue;
201:         }
202:         catch (MalformedURLException e) {
203:           // Not an IOException; this is our own fault.
204:           throw new ISE(
205:               e,
206:               "failed to build url with path[%] and query string [%s].",
207:               request.getUrl().getPath(),
208:               request.getUrl().getQuery()
209:           );
210:         }
211:       }
212: 
213:       HttpResponseStatus responseStatus = fullResponseHolder.getResponse().getStatus();
214:       if (HttpResponseStatus.TEMPORARY_REDIRECT.equals(responseStatus)) {
215:         String redirectUrlStr = fullResponseHolder.getResponse().headers().get("Location");
216:         if (redirectUrlStr == null) {
217:           throw new IOE("No redirect location is found in response from url[%s].", request.getUrl());
218:         }
219: 
220:         log.info("Request[%s] received redirect response to location [%s].", request.getUrl(), redirectUrlStr);
221: 
222:         final URL redirectUrl;
223:         try {
224:           redirectUrl = new URL(redirectUrlStr);
225:         }
226:         catch (MalformedURLException ex) {
227:           throw new IOE(
228:               ex,
229:               "Malformed redirect location is found in response from url[%s], new location[%s].",
230:               request.getUrl(),
231:               redirectUrlStr
232:           );
233:         }
234: 
235:         //update known leader location
236:         currentKnownLeader.set(StringUtils.format(
237:             "%s://%s:%s",
238:             redirectUrl.getProtocol(),
239:             redirectUrl.getHost(),
240:             redirectUrl.getPort()
241:         ));
242: 
243:         request = withUrl(request, redirectUrl);
244:       } else {
245:         return fullResponseHolder;
246:       }
247:     }
248: 
249:     throw new IOE("Retries exhausted, couldn't fulfill request to [%s].", request.getUrl());
250:   }

252:   public String findCurrentLeader()
253:   {
254:     Preconditions.checkState(lifecycleLock.awaitStarted(1, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS));
255:     final StringFullResponseHolder responseHolder;
256:     try {
257:       responseHolder = go(makeRequest(HttpMethod.GET, leaderRequestPath));
258:     }
259:     catch (Exception ex) {
260:       throw new ISE(ex, "Couldn't find leader.");
261:     }
262: 
263:     if (responseHolder.getStatus().getCode() == 200) {
264:       String leaderUrl = responseHolder.getContent();
265: 
266:       //verify this is valid url
267:       try {
268:         URL validatedUrl = new URL(leaderUrl);
269:         currentKnownLeader.set(leaderUrl);
270: 
271:         // validatedUrl.toString() is returned instead of leaderUrl or else teamcity build fails because of breaking
272:         // the rule of ignoring new URL(leaderUrl) object.
273:         return validatedUrl.toString();
274:       }
275:       catch (MalformedURLException ex) {
276:         log.error(ex, "Received malformed leader url[%s].", leaderUrl);
277:       }
278:     }
279: 
280:     throw new ISE(
281:         "Couldn't find leader, failed response status is [%s] and content [%s].",
282:         responseHolder.getStatus().getCode(),
283:         responseHolder.getContent()
284:     );
285:   }
286: 
287:   private String getCurrentKnownLeader(final boolean cached) throws IOException
288:   {
289:     final String leader = currentKnownLeader.accumulateAndGet(
290:         null,
291:         (current, given) -> current == null || !cached ? pickOneHost() : current
292:     );
293: 
294:     if (leader == null) {
295:       throw new IOE("No known server");
296:     } else {
297:       return leader;
298:     }
299:   }
300: 
301:   @Nullable
302:   private String pickOneHost()
303:   {
304:     Iterator<DiscoveryDruidNode> iter = druidNodeDiscovery.getAllNodes().iterator();
305:     if (iter.hasNext()) {
306:       DiscoveryDruidNode node = iter.next();
307:       return StringUtils.format(
308:           "%s://%s",
309:           node.getDruidNode().getServiceScheme(),
310:           node.getDruidNode().getHostAndPortToUse()
311:       );
312:     }
313: 
314:     return null;
315:   }
316: 
317:   private Request withUrl(Request old, URL url)
318:   {
319:     Request req = new Request(old.getMethod(), url);
320:     req.addHeaderValues(old.getHeaders());
321:     if (old.hasContent()) {
322:       req.setContent(old.getContent());
323:     }
324:     return req;
325:   }
326: }
